column3: The Hebrew repeats the same panting verb for deer and soul; BSB varies pants and longs.
The Hebrew has a singular tear; BSB has tears.
The Hebrew describes pouring the soul upon himself and names a festival-keeping crowd; BSB leaves out upon himself and the explicit festival.
The Hebrew has salvations in the plural; BSB has salvation.
The Hebrew has a plural Hermon expression; BSB interprets it as peaks of Hermon.
The Hebrew names salvations of my face; BSB says my Savior.
